<b>Roach Guts</b> is a [[Hunt Wishes|Hunt Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>, started by talking to [[Crull and Benjin]] of [[Sinner's Road]]. As Crull and Benjin are found dead in Act 3, this Wish is removed from the Objectives menu if uncompleted.

== Wish ==
[[File:Roach Guts.png|link=Roach Guts|left|thumb|100x100px]]

Crull and Benjin are low on food, and ask Hornet to obtain 10 [[Roach Guts]], supposedly the best part of a dead [[Muckroach|Muckroach's]] meat. They can be obtained from the corpses of said Muckroaches.

{{Gallery
| Image1 = Mapshot SS Crull and Benjin 01.png!Location of Crull and Benjin in Sinner's Road
| Image2 = Mapshot SS Muckroach 01.png!Locations of Muckroaches in Sinner's Road
}}

== Reward ==
[[File:Tacks.png|link=Tacks|left|thumb|100x100px]]

After completing the Wish, Crull rewards Hornet with the [[Tacks]].

{{Clear}}

== Act 3 ==
In [[Act 3]], Crull and Benjin are found dead. If this Wish has not been completed, the Tacks can freely be claimed from their corpses.
